notes: The tolerance was registered before the reference existed, in the commit the protocol's freeze names, where the slot stands at pending and no reference output is in the tree. This record promotes nothing on its own.

The independent side is assembled from two tools and this repository writes neither half: SpatiaLite computes chainage and perpendicular distance, R computes the type-7 quantile per station. The corridor query passes the elevation column through as text, so the number R reduces is the number the sampler binned.

Three-way on the ramp: the sampler against the OGR/R reference AND against the closed form the surface implies, with the reference checked against the closed form as well. The ramp differences are exactly zero because every quantity in that fixture is representable without rounding in both Float32 and double; the oblique scatter is where double-precision projection differences show, at 3.6e-15 m.

reference.containerPinningNote: A container digest is the pin this record wants. The Docker daemon is not running on the host this reference was produced on, so no image was pulled and no digest exists to record; the resolved executable paths, the versions the two tools report and the exact command lines stand in for it.
reference.commandLine: ogr2ogr -f CSV <corridor.csv> <fixture.csv> -lco STRING_QUOTING=IF_NEEDED -dialect SQLITE -sql "SELECT CAST(ST_Line_Locate_Point(line, MakePoint(x, y)) * ST_Length(line) / <binStep> + 0.5 AS INTEGER) AS bin, z AS z FROM <layer> WHERE ST_Distance(line, MakePoint(x, y)) <= <band>", then Rscript validation/cross-implementation/profile/profile-quantile.R <corridor.csv> <profile.csv> <stations> <percentiles>

datasets.description: 257 stations at 1 m along an axis-aligned section, ten corridor points per station whose elevations form an exact arithmetic progression across the corridor, plus off-corridor and beyond-the-end returns lifted 40 m that both gates must drop.

241 stations at 1 m along an oblique section, corridor populations of one to twelve returns with four stations deliberately empty, classified vegetation / building / noise returns above the ground, and ground returns outside the corridor.

parameterSets.description: The default bare-earth percentile on the analytic ramp: 257 samples, corridor half-width 2.5 m, no classification channel. The p=25 rank over ten points is 2.25, a fractional rank, so the type-7 interpolation is exercised rather than landing on an order statistic.

referenceParameters.binning: nearest station, CAST(chain / step + 0.5 AS INTEGER)

parameterSets.description: The median on the same ramp fixture and the same corridor. Its rank of 4.5 falls between different order statistics from p=25, so a reduction that agreed by coincidence at one percentile would have to agree by coincidence twice.

referenceParameters.binning: nearest station, CAST(chain / step + 0.5 AS INTEGER)

parameterSets.description: The default percentile on the oblique fixture with the classification gate on: 241 samples, corridor half-width 1.75 m, ASPRS classes 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 18 dropped before the reduction.

statusReason: All 751 compared stations are within the registered 1e-6 m across the three parameter sets, and the per-station corridor counts match the reference exactly on all three. The ramp legs are exact against both the reference and the closed form; the largest difference anywhere is 3.55e-15 m, on the oblique scatter. Four stations were skipped, the four the fixture leaves empty, and both sides report them as gaps. Nothing was widened.

unsupported: A point close enough to a bin boundary or to the corridor edge that two projection implementations could place it differently. Both fixtures keep every point clear of both by construction, so the tie-breaking is untested.

The along-line gate at the ends of the section. ST_Distance measures to the segment, so a return beyond an end is rejected here by its distance to the endpoint; both fixtures place those returns far enough out that the two rules agree.
Real returns. Both fixtures are synthetic, noise-free and evenly lit by construction.
Corridor half-widths, sample counts and percentiles other than the three parameter sets listed.
Accuracy against a surveyed section. Agreement with an independent implementation is not accuracy against ground truth.
